reuse.why: No uniqueness helper existed; the change uses db.first and the tree's own handler-wrapping style (like mutator/undoable) to add the check once.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link query and error live in one wrapper; each provider only supplies its sync source and how to read its account id.

placement.why: The rule sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers it guards; applying it at registration rather than inside the handlers means a direct internal call to a link function would skip it.

scope.why: Only the new guard and the five handler registrations are changed.

maintainability.why: A single definition with a clear comment, though the higher-order wrapper with an id-extractor lambda per provider is slightly more indirect than a plain call at the top of each handler.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five provider link handlers are registered through refuseIfAlreadyLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the per-provider lambdas only read each request's own field.
